Prototype · North Star by Developing Experts · November 2026

Every Rolls-⁠Royce SMR employee gets a North Star.

North Star is one platform for learning, progression and workforce planning. Staff take their courses in its Learning Zone with an AI tutor alongside every step. Each result builds a competency profile and a route to the role they want next, their North Star. Rolls-⁠Royce SMR sees who is ready, who needs support and what each new SMR will need, and what it will cost.

ClientRolls-⁠Royce SMR
Delivered byDeveloping Experts and PA Consulting
First courseEXP-100 Export Control
StatusPrototype

01

The opportunity

Rolls-⁠Royce SMR is scaling fast. Public listings show around 430 open roles across design, C&I, manufacturing, safety, delivery, supply chain and corporate functions, with Wylfa confirmed as the first UK site and export deployments in progress. The sector's hardest gaps are in new-build skills: commissioning, construction, project controls and reactor engineering.

The UK Nuclear Skills Plan expects the sector to grow from 83,000 to 123,000 skilled people by 2030, and its Optimising Training Landscape work calls for standardised role profiles and career paths. Developing Experts already works with Rolls-⁠Royce SMR, Sellafield, EDF, NNL and the MOD on nuclear skills in 6,000+ UK schools. North Star extends that pipeline into the workforce.

There is also a platform window. This year Rolls-⁠Royce SMR trains its people on Rolls-Royce plc's learning platform; next year it plans its own. North Star can run alongside the plc platform now and become Rolls-⁠Royce SMR's own training platform when it moves.

Every member of staff takes the Export Control course, because everyone handles controlled nuclear technology in some form. That makes it the right first course: it produces comparable evidence about every employee from day one.

A talent pipeline

Safe to be unsure. The tutor works best when people feel free to get things wrong and say when they are not sure, which matters in a strong safety culture. So what someone gets wrong while learning, and what they ask the tutor, stays private to them. Managers see section results, and misconceptions only as team patterns shared by three or more people. Readiness scores measure knowledge and how well people apply it. Moving into a role also takes experience, supervised practice, SQEP sign-off and the manager’s judgement. These settings are for Rolls-⁠Royce SMR to decide.

03

The Export Control course, broken down

EXP-100 is the case study because every member of staff takes it, so it gives comparable evidence across the whole workforce from day one. EXP-100 is split into eight subsections. Each one has the misconceptions staff most often bring with them, and each is mapped to the competencies it gives evidence for. The AI tutor probes for the misconceptions and the progression module uses the mapping.

#SubsectionLikely misconceptionsCompetencies evidenced
S1Why export control matters in civil nuclear
Non-proliferation, national security, consequences for the company and individuals.
S1a Export control is a paperwork formality, not a safety or security issue
S1b Civil nuclear technology is peaceful, so it is lightly controlled
SSC ×3REG ×2LDR ×1
S2The legal framework
UK Export Control Order 2008, UK strategic control lists, Nuclear Suppliers Group, US 10 CFR 810 and Part 110, EU dual-use regulation for partner countries.
S2a Only UK law applies because we are a UK company
S2b Sanctions and export controls are the same regime
REG ×3INT ×2
S3Classifying goods, software and technology
Control list ratings, Category 0 nuclear items, dual-use, document export markings.
S3a If it is not a physical item it cannot be controlled
S3b A "Not Subject to Export Controls" marking covers anything derived from that document
S3c An export marking is the same as a security classification
TEC ×3REG ×2INF ×1
S4Intangible technology transfer
Email, cloud, screen share, visits, conversations and access by overseas nationals.
S4a Emailing a colleague in our own company is never an export
S4b Talking a design through on a video call is not a transfer
S4c Uploading to the cloud is fine if the company owns the account
INF ×3RSK ×2INT ×1

Open general, standard individual and open individual licences; conditions; record keeping.
S5a One licence covers all future work with the same partner
S5b An open general licence means no licence is needed
REG ×3SCM ×2RSK ×1

End-user screening, catch-all controls, diversion warning signs.
S6a If an item is not on a control list, a licence can never be required
S6b Screening a customer once at contract signature is enough
RSK ×3SCM ×2SSC ×1

Flow-down to suppliers, re-exports, technical assistance, overseas deployments.
S7a Once goods reach a partner, what they re-export is their problem
S7b Verbal technical help to an overseas supplier is not controlled
INT ×3SCM ×2COM ×1

Recognising a breach, internal reporting, voluntary disclosure, audit trail.

S8b Compliance is the Trade Compliance team’s job, not mine

We have assumed the "Export course" is Export Control and trade compliance, and that the tutor can report which misconceptions a learner showed and whether they were resolved. Both need confirming with Rolls-⁠Royce SMR.

04

How the tutor finds where understanding breaks

The AI tutor diagnoses a misconception and then steps down a demand ladder, asking a Socratic question at each step until it finds the point where the learner's model breaks. It then climbs back to the original question so the learner states the answer themselves. Here is how that works in an Export Control scenario.

StepTutor asksEmployee answersWhat it reveals
TargetA colleague asks you to email the pump seal drawings to our module supplier in Brno. What do you need to check before sending?"Nothing. It's an internal email to our own supply chain."S4a Thinks sending within the company's network is never an export.
1 · Re-anchorThe email starts in our system. Where are the drawings once the supplier opens them?"In Czechia, but they're still our drawings."A second misconception surfaces: owning the technology means it is not controlled.
2 · PrerequisiteExport control applies when technology crosses a border, whoever owns it. So what has happened when the file arrives in Brno?"It's been exported?"Reasons correctly to the definition of a transfer.
3 · NarrowRight, that is a technology transfer. Before sending, which do you check? A) the drawing's export control rating and marking, B) the supplier's ISO certificate, C) the file size, D) nothing, because they signed an NDA."A?"Confirms the corrected model, tentatively.
4 · ReturnSo the drawing may need a licence. What would you do before pressing send?"Check the marking, confirm with Trade Compliance that a licence covers this supplier, and keep a record."States the correct process unaided. S4a resolved.

What North Star reads from each ladder

Misconceptions diagnosed and resolved, any new ones that surfaced, the lowest step reached, whether a multiple-choice scaffold was needed, turns taken and time to resolution. Resolving unaided counts as stronger evidence than resolving with a scaffold.

Session length, and why we will measure it

There is no research-backed question limit. Evidence on digital attention (Kizilcec), cognitive load (Sweller), effective tutoring (EEF) and self-pacing (Kestin et al., 2025) points to a working estimate: one ladder in 3 to 6 turns or 2 to 4 minutes, and a practice session under 10 to 15 minutes. North Star logs actual time to resolution per misconception during the pilot so the real thresholds come from data.

05

How a score becomes a route

What counts as held

A person is assumed to meet the requirements of the role they hold today. Course evidence can lift a competency above that. If course evidence falls below their current role's requirement, the manager sees a flag.

Secure or fragile

The tutor tracks confidence alongside correctness. A correct but unconfident answer is fragile and counts at 90% weight until a delayed re-test in the Retain stage confirms it. Secure evidence counts in full.

What counts as ready

Readiness for a role is the share of its requirements already met. A rung is "ready" at 90% or more with no single gap above one level. Everything is advisory: North Star informs development conversations and never makes selection decisions.

06

The learning loop

07

Roles, competencies and course pathways

We have compiled the roles Rolls-⁠Royce SMR is currently advertising and grouped them into 11 job families, each with a five-level ladder from apprentice or graduate to head of function. Every role has required levels for nine shared competencies plus the technical competencies of its family. Each family has its own course pathway, built on a common core that starts with EXP-100.

Nine shared competencies

REG Regulatory & legal compliance
Knows and applies the law and licence conditions that govern the work.
INF Information & technology control
Handles controlled data, software and technology correctly, including digital transfers.
RSK Risk judgement
Spots red flags and makes proportionate decisions under uncertainty.
SSC Nuclear safety & security culture
Puts nuclear safety, security and non-proliferation first.
SCM Commercial & supply chain
Applies obligations through contracts, suppliers and partners.
INT International collaboration
Works compliantly with overseas partners, regulators and colleagues.
TEC Technical analysis
Understands the technology well enough to classify and assess it.
COM Communication & escalation
Raises concerns early and clearly, and records decisions.
LDR Leadership & accountability
Owns outcomes and builds the right culture in others.

Five levels

L1 Foundation
Apprentice or graduate. Follows procedures under supervision and asks before acting.
L2 Practitioner
Applies the rules to routine work without supervision and spots issues.
L3 Senior
Handles complex cases, reviews others’ work and coaches.
L4 Lead / Manager
Accountable for a team or area and sets local standards.
L5 Head / Principal
Sets strategy and policy and represents the company externally.
Proficiency scale for each competency: 1 Aware · 2 Knowledgeable · 3 Practitioner · 4 Expert · 5 Authority.

Access

SSO with Rolls-⁠Royce SMR identity. Employees see only their own data. Managers see direct reports only. Admins see aggregated, anonymised views.

Data protection

UK GDPR: DPIA before pilot, data minimised to learner ID, role and learning events. No automated decisions about pay, promotion or selection.

Hosting

UK-hosted. Export-control-marked content stays in access-controlled course storage; progression data holds scores and IDs, not course content.

09

From case study to every course

Once the Export Control case study has proved the method, the same process is applied to every course staff take. Each new course becomes another evidence source for North Star, so profiles get richer and the level of evidence North Star can confirm rises from practitioner to expert and leader.

The recipe for onboarding any course

  1. Load the approved course material into the Learning Zone with the course builder.
  2. Break the course into subsections of 2 to 4 minute ladders and 10 to 15 minute sessions.
  3. Identify the misconceptions each subsection is likely to surface, with subject experts.
  4. Map each subsection to the competencies it evidences, with weights and the highest level it can confirm.
  5. Pilot with one cohort, compare North Star's readiness with manager judgement, then release to all staff who take the course.

Steps 1 to 3 are the standard content process. Step 4 is a configuration, not new software.

The AI tutor as the support layer on every course

Whatever the delivery (classroom, blended, e-learning or an external provider), each course gets the AI tutor alongside it. The tutor supports each learner and analyses the course, and North Star turns the analysis into progression evidence.

WhenSupport for the learnerAnalysis for managers and course owners
BeforeDiagnostic pre-check; skip what they already know; spot the misconceptions they bringStarting knowledge by section and misconceptions on entry, so cohorts and instructor time are targeted
DuringSocratic ladders on each misconception, 3 to 6 turns or 2 to 4 minutes; targeted explanationsTime to resolve, ladder depth, new misconceptions surfaced, sections where cohorts struggle
ProveRe-ask the original question with a confidence check; mastery at 80%Mastery by section, secure versus fragile answers
AfterSpaced, mixed review at 1, 3, 6 and 12 weeksRetention and decay; refresher timing
EvidenceProgress shown against their North StarCompetency scores, readiness for the next level, accelerating or at-risk flags

Tutor support is priced per place (a placeholder of £40, set under Manage & order) and included in order and project costs. The Pathways tab shows each course's tutor status and analysis.

10

Workforce planning for every SMR

North Star supports the company as well as the individual. Because it knows every employee's competency profile, it can compare the people Rolls-⁠Royce SMR has with the people each SMR needs. When a new SMR is commissioned, the planner shows how many staff it needs in each job family and level, how many existing staff are ready, how many can be upskilled or promoted, how many must be recruited, and exactly which courses to order and schedule, and when.

12

Assumptions and open questions

  • Rolls-⁠Royce SMR has not published its internal competency framework. The framework here is a starting draft built from public job listings and recognised nuclear and engineering standards. Rolls-⁠Royce SMR should replace or validate it in Discovery.
  • Role titles marked "Live listing" were seen in current public vacancies. Titles marked "Framework" fill gaps in a ladder and need confirming.
  • Follow-on course codes and titles are proposals. Some will map to existing Rolls-⁠Royce SMR or Rolls-Royce Group courses.
  • After the case study, every course is onboarded with the same recipe. The order of stages 2 to 4 is a suggestion to agree with Rolls-⁠Royce SMR's learning team.
  • Each SMR will have a set number of people for every post (domain and level). Rolls-⁠Royce SMR has not yet confirmed these, so the SMR staffing page uses estimates from a standard template and marks each number as confirmed or to be confirmed.
  • Staff numbers per SMR, the split by family and level, unit dates and the current workforce profile in the planner are illustrative. Public sources give only headline figures: about 1,440 Rolls-⁠Royce SMR employees (Revelio Labs estimate), a 500-day construction target, up to three units at Wylfa with around 3,000 direct site roles at peak, early works with ČEZ at Temelín in Czechia, and Videberg Kraft's selection of Rolls-⁠Royce SMR for three units at Värö in Sweden (June 2026). Rolls-⁠Royce SMR should replace them with its own resourcing model.
  • The Learning Zone opens on EXP-100 Export Control, written for this prototype with the AI tutor built in; its wording needs validating by Rolls-⁠Royce SMR Trade Compliance. Other courses can be built in the Course studio or imported from Developing Experts' content studio.
  • The move from the Rolls-Royce plc platform, and the timing of Rolls-⁠Royce SMR's own platform, need confirming with Rolls-⁠Royce SMR's learning team.
  • All people and scores in the employee and manager views are fictional sample data.
  • In the global talent pipeline, VWE, outreach, regional and induction pages, every person, vacancy, salary, rent, conversion rate and regional figure is sample data, except where a source is named (for example, Welsh speakers from Census 2021). Market facts are from public announcements up to June 2026 and should be checked before each use.
  • Using VWEs as a recruitment screen needs a review with Rolls-⁠Royce SMR's recruitment, inclusion, legal and data protection teams, including a data protection impact assessment. North Star never makes a hiring decision on its own: a recruiter reviews every borderline case and every candidate gets feedback.
  • Photos are placeholders with a shot brief for each. Translated menus are samples pending translator review.
  • The AI tutor proof of concept is deliberately small: EXP-100 test-outs for 10 to 15 new starters at one site over six weeks. Its success measures need agreeing with the sponsor before it starts.

13

Questions to shape the full platform

The pilot answers whether the AI tutor works. If it does, these are the questions to settle with Rolls-⁠Royce SMR before designing the full platform.

QuestionWhere North Star could go
Workforce planning and FTEsThe planner counts posts per SMR. Next, it could connect to Rolls-⁠Royce SMR’s workforce planning tools and plan in FTEs and budgets, not just headcount.
Contractors and the whole workforceA strategic workforce plan needs everyone who does the work. Contractors and supplier staff could be added as their own worker type, with agreed access to courses and evidence.
Skills or rolesNorth Star is role-led today, with competencies under each role. It could be skills-led, with roles as bundles of skills. The choice shapes pathways, internal moves and planning.
Performance and competence assessmentCourse and tutor evidence covers knowledge. Learning on the job, assessor sign-off, qualifications, experience and SQEP authorisation could sit alongside it in each person’s profile.
A digital passportA verified record of courses, external qualifications, licences and authorisations that people carry between sites and roles. This includes contractors.
One place, or part of a setNorth Star could become one place for learning, performance and talent. Or it could focus on learning and progression and feed the systems Rolls-⁠Royce SMR already uses.
ERP and HR systemsWe need to agree which system holds the master record for people, roles and organisation structure, and how North Star connects to it. Section 08 sets out a starting point.

14

A global talent pipeline for every market

Rolls-⁠Royce SMR's workforce will not come only from its own staff. Each SMR needs about a thousand people on site at peak, hundreds in operations for 60 years, and a factory supply chain behind it. North Star extends outwards to build that workforce in every market: the UK, where Wylfa is contracted; Czechia, where early works at Temelín have begun; Sweden, where Videberg Kraft has selected Rolls-⁠Royce SMR for the Värö peninsula; and the markets being explored with partners in Poland, the Netherlands, Finland, Estonia, Ukraine and Turkey.

CapabilityWhat it does in each market
Virtual work experiences as the first screenEvery vacancy has a VWE. Candidates make a real decision and explain it; the AI tutor marks the explanation against the role rubric. Recruiters see blind, ranked evidence instead of CVs, with a four-fifths fairness check on every vacancy, and everyone gets feedback.
Support and training for teachersFree CPD in the Learning Zone, a lesson to teach before each VWE, class codes to set VWEs and see results, teacher industry days, engineers in the classroom and a named regional education lead.

Applicants choose what is shared before anything is scored.

Sample data

Virtual work experiences

VWE screening for recruiters

Rolls-⁠Royce SMR uses VWEs as the first screen for applicants. Instead of sifting CVs, recruiters see what each person did in the job and how they explained it, ranked against the role's rubric, with blind screening and a fairness check on every vacancy.

Sample applicants

Virtual work experiences

Support and training for teachers

Teachers and careers leads are how VWEs reach every pupil. North Star gives them free CPD, a lesson to teach before each VWE, a simple way to set VWEs for a class and see results, industry days, engineers in the classroom, and a named person to call.

Sample data

Regional impact and reporting

Regional data explorer

Results for every local authority around each site, and by ward on Ynys Môn: who North Star reaches, who finishes a VWE, applies and is hired, alongside the local labour market. Break it down by audience, age, job family or user type.

Sample data · real areas

Regional impact and reporting

Regional plans and policy fit

How North Star's data feeds the plans government and regions use to fund skills: regional skills partnerships, Local Skills Improvement Plans, Local Growth Plans, the Freeport and national programmes, with an export ready to paste.

Sample data

Regional impact and reporting

Board and government report

A quarterly report built from live data, written for each audience: the Board, UK and Welsh Government, local partners, and customers in Czechia and Sweden.

Sample data

People & progress

Fast-track induction with the AI tutor

Every new starter gets an induction built around what they already know. Their Skills Passport and VWE evidence carry over, the AI tutor lets them test out of modules they have mastered, and the time saved goes into getting them working on their own sooner, safely. It starts with a small proof of concept on one module.

Sample new starters

You

My profile

Your own space in North Star. Applicants and learners personalise their profile, track their progress and badges, and decide who sees their results. Rolls-⁠Royce SMR employees manage their courses, objectives, check-ins and development towards their North Star.

Global talent pipeline

Supply chain recruitment

Rolls-⁠Royce SMR's suppliers recruit through North Star too. A vacancy API, plug-ins for applicant tracking systems and a simple form bring their roles onto the same vacancies page, each with a matching 30-minute taster, and a widget puts "Try this role" on their own careers pages.

Sandbox · sample suppliers

Learning

Interactive simulations

Every course an employee takes is built to be visual and hands-on: a short film to open, a real scenario, a simulation to practise in, the AI tutor alongside, and spaced quizzes so it sticks. Try three of the simulations here.

You

My best-fit jobs

Every open role, ranked by how well it fits you, with the reasons, the gaps and a clear next step: apply now, take the taster first, or build skills first. Tick up to three to compare them side by side.

EXP-100 Export Control Essentials

AI tutor · Live

Learning Zone with AI tutor · 2 weeks · 8 sections · 18 misconceptions in the library · Tutor support: Included: this course runs in the Learning Zone with the AI tutor

How the tutor supports learners

StageSupportWhat it analyses
DiagnoseShort pre-check on all 8 sections. Learners skip what they can already show they know; the tutor finds which of the 18 known misconceptions each person holds.Starting knowledge by section; misconceptions present on entry.
Confront & correctA Socratic demand ladder for each misconception, aiming to resolve it in 3 to 6 turns or 2 to 4 minutes, with explanations, diagrams or analogies aimed at the exact gap.Turns and time to resolve each misconception; lowest ladder step reached; new misconceptions surfaced.
ProveRe-asks the original question and records confidence. A section only counts as mastered at 80% or more with a confident answer.Mastery by section; secure versus fragile answers.
RetainSpaced, mixed review at 1, 3, 6 and 12 weeks, weighted by memory strength.Delayed re-test scores and decay; which sections fade first.
Evidence to North StarResults feed the competencies this course builds: Regulatory & legal compliance, Information & technology control, Risk judgement.Competency scores, readiness for the next level and North Star flags for managers.

Commission a new SMR

Add an SMR as soon as it is ordered. North Star sets its staffing quota from the standard template (marked to be confirmed), adds it to the workforce planner, SMR staffing, tracker and order forms, and can raise draft course orders straight away.

    Rolls-⁠Royce SMR · AI tutor case study

    North Star guided demo

    The demo drives the platform itself: it switches views, takes the Export Control course, answers a question wrongly so the tutor can step in, and runs the live simulation. Each pop-up summarises the feature on screen.

    To add audio, start the tour, go to a stop and choose Add audio in its pop-up. The tour pauses while you upload. A stop with audio plays it, then moves on when it finishes.

    Space pause or resume · → next · ← back · Esc leave the demo. Use the contents list in any pop-up to jump to a section during questions.
